English: In a searing flash of light, the angel is torn from existence. For a moment you see it tumbling into the fractal madness of the void, just before the rip in reality snaps shut.
Chinese: 在一道灼目的闪光中,天使被从存在中撕去。就在现实的裂口猛然闭合之前,你看见它翻滚着坠入虚空那分形的疯狂之中。

English: The Cradle lurches around you. Without its power source, it has begun to plummet back to the Underlands.
Chinese: 摇篮在你周围猛然倾斜。失去了能量来源,它开始朝地下之地直坠而下。

English: It is only thanks to the nimble piloting of Jack Basalt that you are rescued from the wreckage. You watch its metal carcass fall below the clouds, taking what remains of Vela and her former comrades with it.
Chinese: 多亏杰克·巴索特娴熟的驾驶技术,你才从残骸中被救了出来。你眼看着那具金属躯壳坠入云层之下,薇拉的残躯和她昔日同伴们的遗骸也随之而去。

English: It is only thanks to the nimble piloting of Jack Basalt that you are rescued from the wreckage. Ignoring her frantic protests, you shove Vela on the craft as well - and the three of you watch the Cradle fall below the clouds.
Chinese: 多亏杰克·巴索特娴熟的驾驶技术,你才从残骸中被救了出来。不顾她疯狂的抗议,你把薇拉也推上了飞艇——你们三人一同望着摇篮坠入云层之下。

English: You are silent on the journey back, thinking only of Orlaith, the Duchess and Caxton Frost, for whom the Cradle will forever be a tomb.
Chinese: 归途中你一言不发,心中只想着奥莱丝、女公爵和卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特——对他们而言,摇篮将永远是一座坟墓。

English: In the years that follow, you rise through the ranks of the Inquisition, spreading fear wherever your boots tread.
Chinese: 此后的岁月里,你在宗教裁判所中节节高升,靴子踏到哪里,恐惧就蔓延到哪里。

English: Your name soon gains a fearsome reputation, whispered with trepidation and reverence across the Apostatic Union.
Chinese: 你的名字很快便有了令人胆寒的名声,在叛教联盟的每个角落被人怀着敬畏低声传诵。

English: With your penitence fulfilled, you are released from the Inquisition. Your subsequent clashes with authority see you falling in with the very mercenaries you once fought - the Dark Stars.
Chinese: 赎罪期满,你从宗教裁判所获释。此后与当权者的屡屡冲突,让你最终投奔了自己曾经的敌人——黑星佣兵团。

English: It is not long before you gain respect, infamy and even command, just like Vela before you. ##Some call you a tyrant; others, a liberator. But one thing is certain: that all over the skyrealms your name is known.
Chinese: 没过多久,你便赢得了敬重、恶名,甚至统领之权,正如当年的薇拉一样。##有人说你是暴君,有人说你是解放者。但有一件事是确定的:整个天空领域都知道你的名字。

English: With your penitence fulfilled, you are released from the Inquisition. Free at last, you set off alone, caring not where the wind takes you.
Chinese: 赎罪期满,你从宗教裁判所获释。终于自由了,你独自上路,任凭风吹向何方。

English: In the years that follow, tales are told around the Skyrealms of a lone wanderer whose very presence seems to put strange events in motion.
Chinese: 此后的岁月里,天空领域流传着一名独行浪客的传说:所到之处,怪事似乎总随之发生。

English: Jack Basalt retires from mercenary work and spends the rest of his days drifting from tavern to tavern, drunkenly rambling of his bygone exploits.
Chinese: 杰克·巴索特金盆洗手,不再做雇佣兵,余生流连于各家酒馆之间,醉醺醺地絮叨着自己昔日的功绩。

English: With time, the names of his former comrades are forgotten, and he is regarded as just another old fool.
Chinese: 时光流逝,昔日同伴的名字渐渐被遗忘,他也被当作又一个老糊涂。

English: Frost never marries his lover, Sammol. He remains a traitor in the eyes of his homeland.
Chinese: 弗罗斯特始终没有迎娶爱人萨莫尔。在故国眼中,他永远是叛徒。

English: The Duchess, shredded and scattered to the winds, finds a strange new peace as a fractured witness to the secret life of the Underlands.
Chinese: 女公爵被撕碎、随风四散,却以破碎之躯见证着地下之地的隐秘生机,寻得一种奇异的安宁。

English: The Emberian's armour lies, unrusting, at the base of the world, while her flesh returns to the soil.
Chinese: 余烬人的铠甲不朽不锈,静卧在世界之底;她的血肉则归于尘土。

English: Their sacrifice is recorded on the jet-black memorial obelisk that stands in the gardens of the Citadel of Doubt in Riova.
Chinese: 他们的牺牲被铭刻在里奥瓦怀疑堡花园中那座漆黑的纪念方尖碑上。

English: And as for Vela? Now she lives only in history books, and wicked rhymes to scare children.
Chinese: 至于薇拉?如今她只活在史书之中,活在那吓唬小孩的邪恶歌谣里。

English: And as for Vela? You shared few words during your escape. The next day she was gone, and none have seen or heard from her since.
Chinese: 至于薇拉?逃亡途中你们没说上几句话。第二天她就走了,此后再无人见过她,也无人听到过她的消息。

English: The angel beckons. As you tumble into its mind, your consciousness twists, strains and bursts, spilling into the universe.
Chinese: 天使向你招手。当你坠入它的心智,你的意识扭曲、紧绷、而后迸裂,倾泻进浩瀚宇宙。

English: You see it now, for the first time. A tapestry of words, lines, and verses thread themselves through every corner of existence. With a few twists of your tongue you could change it all.
Chinese: 你第一次看清了它的全貌。一张由词句与诗行织成的锦缎,贯穿存在的每一个角落。只需转动几下舌头,你便能改变这一切。

English: And you do.
Chinese: 而你做到了。

English: Your words reverberate through reality. A few utterances reverse the finality of death and the frigid linearity of mortal existence. With another sentence, you bestow upon each person the smallest droplet of your newfound power.
Chinese: 你的话语在现实中回荡。寥寥数语,便逆转了死亡的不可挽回,融化了凡人生存那冰冷的直线。再一句话,你便将自己新得的力量,化作最微小的一滴,赐予每一个人。

English: All across the skyrealms, everyone - from the noble to the downtrodden - feels a surge of understanding beyond that of any cipher wizard.
Chinese: 整个天空领域,从贵族到贱民,每个人都感到一股超越任何密文法师的顿悟涌上心头。

English: The long dead, silent for centuries or more, find they need only open their eyes and breathe.
Chinese: 长眠数百年甚至更久的亡者发现,自己只需睁开眼睛,呼吸空气。

English: Among them are your companions. Basalt, Orlaith, Frost and the Duchess stand ashore, watching your ascendancy to something beyond godhood.
Chinese: 其中就有你的同伴。巴索特、奥莱丝、弗罗斯特和女公爵站在岸边,看着你超越神性,扶摇直上。

English: And here, in the Oneiric Isles, you contrive a resplendent city to oversee this new age.
Chinese: 而在梦幻群岛,你缔造了一座辉煌之城,来俯瞰这个新时代。

English: You understand that with its new gifts, humanity will writhe and struggle like newborn babes. Without your guiding hand, chaos could engulf the world.
Chinese: 你明白,得到新的天赋后,人类会像初生的婴儿一样挣扎扭动。若没有你的引导,混乱将吞噬整个世界。

English: So you name this city Heaven; where watchtowers of cipher gaze unblinking, and legions of angelic guardians stand ever ready to protect what you have built.
Chinese: 于是你将这座城命名为天堂:密文瞭望塔不知疲倦地凝视四方,天使卫队整装待发,守护着你的一切造物。

English: And here, in the Oneiric Isles, you plant the seed of a new city to grow in this era of boundless possibility.
Chinese: 而在梦幻群岛,你播下一座新城的种子,让它在充满无限可能的时代里生长。

English: You name this city Heaven, to act as a nexus of change and growth, overseen by your ever-present gaze.
Chinese: 你将这座城命名为天堂,让它成为变革与成长的枢纽,在你的目光注视之下。

English: Though you refuse to stoop to the Inquisition's level by simply erasing it from existence, your city of dissidents and heretics becomes a riotous rebuke to everything it stands for, and a catalyst for transformation across the Skyrealms.
Chinese: 你拒绝像宗教裁判所那样把它从存在中抹去——那太掉价了。这座异见者与异教徒之城,成了对宗教裁判所一切信条的喧闹驳斥,也成了整个天空领域变革的催化剂。

English: And here, in the Oneiric Isles, you seal yourself away in a womb of cipher. A city soon propagates around you, but you pay it no heed.
Chinese: 而在梦幻群岛,你将自己封存于密文织就的母腹之中。一座城市很快在你周围繁衍起来,你却不闻不问。

English: You let the new world of possibilities unfurl like petals, intervening as little as possible. Paths stretch ahead, to places both sunlit and dark, and even your new vision cannot see which one humanity will choose.
Chinese: 你任由这个充满可能的新世界如花瓣般舒展,尽量不加干涉。道路在眼前延伸,通向光明与黑暗之地,就连你的新视野也看不透人类将选择哪一条。

English: Jack Basalt retires from mercenary work, drifting through the skyrealms in a rickety old boat. On occasion he is seen in one port or another, beguiling children with swashbuckling stories that seem too outlandish to be true.
Chinese: 杰克·巴索特不再做雇佣兵,驾着一艘破旧的小船漂泊于天空领域之间。偶尔有人在某个港口见到他,给孩子们讲着刀光剑影的冒险故事,离奇得让人难以相信。

English: Frost marries his lover, Sammol; and they raise their children with stories of skyfaring adventures, on a quiet little island on the edge of the skyrealms.
Chinese: 弗罗斯特迎娶了爱人萨莫尔,在天空领域边缘一座宁静的小岛上,用飞天航海的冒险故事养育子女。

English: The Duchess, her youth restored, begins a journey to find her daughter - which takes her to the Underlands. In a grove of newly blossoming trees she sees that beaming smile at last.
Chinese: 女公爵恢复了青春,踏上寻找女儿的旅途——一路来到地下之地。在那片初绽新花的树林里,她终于看见了那灿烂的笑容。

English: And the Emberian finally sets down her armour, allowing the burden of her ancestors to finally lift from her shoulders.
Chinese: 而余烬人终于卸下铠甲,祖先的重担终于从她肩头卸落。

English: And as for Vela? You could never detect her lifeforce in the throb and pulse of reality. It seems that in the end, she did not have the will to embrace her own dream.
Chinese: 至于薇拉?在现实世界的搏动与脉动中,你再也没能探测到她的生命气息。看来最终,她还是没有勇气拥抱自己的梦。

English: And as for Vela? The last time you cast your gaze on her, she was embracing her sister, tears in both of their eyes.
Chinese: 至于薇拉?你最后一次望见她时,她正拥抱着妹妹,两人眼中都含着泪水。

English: Thanks to your assistance, the Apostatic Union is able to purge the Wikkan covens from every corner of Hallowshire.
Chinese: 多亏你的协助,叛教联盟得以将维坎教团从哈洛郡的每个角落清除出去。

English: The region enjoys a new era of stability and lawfulness, though despite many pleas for aid to the Union mainland, the famine drags on for several years.
Chinese: 这片地区迎来了稳定与法治的新时代,但尽管多次向联盟本土求援,饥荒仍持续了数年之久。

English: With your status as an Inquisition agent, you personally oversee this process, and it is your efforts that ensure the gods of this region fade into mere legend.
Chinese: 你以宗教裁判所特工的身份亲自监督这一过程,正是你的努力,确保了这片土地的诸神沦为纯粹的传说。

English: With you at the helm, the Dark Stars become a persistent thorn in the Union's side, cultivating a cut-throat criminal network under their noses.
Chinese: 在你的掌舵下,黑星佣兵团成了联盟的心腹之刺,在他们眼皮底下培育起一个凶残的犯罪网络。

English: In time, the Apostatic Union is able to wrest control of Hallowshire from the Wikkan covens.
Chinese: 最终,叛教联盟得以从维坎教团手中夺过哈洛郡的控制权。

English: The region enjoys a new era of stability and lawfulness, though despite many pleas for aid to the Union mainland, the famine drags on for several years.
Chinese: 这片地区迎来了稳定与法治的新时代,但尽管多次向联盟本土求援,饥荒仍持续了数年之久。

English: Thanks to your assistance, Paeguth and the Wikkan covens chase the Apostatic Union out of Hallowshire.
Chinese: 多亏你的协助,帕古斯与维坎教团将叛教联盟赶出了哈洛郡。

English: Rumours spread of terrible afflictions that twist and deform the region's populace, but one thing is certain: their harvests are bountiful and their bellies are always full.
Chinese: 流言四起,说这片土地的居民被可怕的邪祟扭曲变形,但有一点是确定的:他们收成丰饶,肚皮始终饱满。

English: As a member of the Inquisition, you grow to regret your past actions; Hallowshire is regarded as the organisation's greatest failure.
Chinese: 作为宗教裁判所的一员,你渐渐为昔日的所作所为悔恨不已;哈洛郡被视为这个组织最大的失败。

English: As the leader of the Dark Stars, the Paeguth cult becomes a recurring client; and your mercenaries spend many wild and delirious nights in the spore-strewn streets of Hallow Town.
Chinese: 作为黑星佣兵团的首领,帕古斯邪教成了你的老主顾;你的雇佣兵们则在哈洛镇孢子纷飞的街道上,度过了许多癫狂迷乱的夜晚。

English: Thanks to your help, the Apostatic Union is able to cling to power in Hallowshire, despite the chaotic transition into this new reality.
Chinese: 多亏你的帮助,叛教联盟才得以在哈洛郡勉强掌权,熬过向这个新现实混乱的过渡期。

English: As the region transforms into a surreal and shifting wonderland, the Union are able to temper its excesses while ensuring a semblance of order and normalcy.
Chinese: 当这片土地蜕变为超现实、不断变化的奇境时,联盟得以约束其过度之处,维持住秩序与日常的表象。

English: They are aided by your ever-watchful eye, for when events threaten to erupt into turmoil, the guardians of Heaven react swiftly and thoroughly.
Chinese: 他们有你时刻警醒的目光相助:一旦事态即将失控,天堂的守护者们便会迅速而彻底地出手。

English: Though you try to encourage a more egalitarian spread of power, the Union proves tenacious.
Chinese: 尽管你试图推动权力的均分,联盟却展现出顽强的生命力。

English: Thanks to your help, Paeguth grows to be the dominant power in Hallowshire, overseeing the region's transformation into a realm of anarchic fecundity.
Chinese: 多亏你的帮助,帕古斯成长为哈洛郡的主宰力量,见证着这片土地蜕变为无序而丰饶的国度。

English: Over time, the people here shed their mortal skins and change into a cornucopia of outlandish forms, enraptured in their own decadent and peculiar rituals.
Chinese: 随着时间推移,这里的人们蜕下凡人的躯壳,幻化成千奇百怪的姿态,沉醉于自己颓废而诡异的仪式之中。

English: From your seat in Heaven, you regard this unbridled chaos with wary eyes, and regularly intervene to quash those elements that endanger the common good.
Chinese: 你从天堂的宝座上警惕地注视着这无度的混沌,时常出手铲除那些危害公益的因素。

English: Though all are equal in Heaven, you cannot help but favour these new citizens; ushering them forth as shining examples of this new era.
Chinese: 尽管天堂之中人人平等,你却难免偏袒这些新子民,将他们奉为新时代的光辉典范。

English: Taking advantage of this new reality, Paeguth grows to be the dominant power in Hallowshire, overseeing the region's transformation into a realm of anarchic fecundity.
Chinese: 帕古斯趁势利用这一新现实,成长为哈洛郡的主宰力量,见证着这片土地蜕变为无序而丰饶的国度。

English: In the Endless Realm, your plotting ensures that the Entombed One is able to defeat the Queen of Silver and her council.
Chinese: 在无尽领域,你的密谋确保了墓中人能够击败白银女王和她的议会。

English: The entire realm is soon torn asunder by violent magics, fuelled by the agonies and resentments of its denizens.
Chinese: 整个国度很快被狂暴的魔法撕成碎片,而点燃这些魔法的,正是岛上居民的苦痛与怨愤。

English: Of the few small islands that remain, a handful of Endless survivors cling to a miserable existence, comforted only by the hope that their brethren have found some kind of peace.
Chinese: 在残存的寥寥几座小岛上,一小撮无尽者幸存者挣扎求生,唯一的安慰,是希望他们的同胞已在某处寻得安宁。

English: The Entombed One, festering below Sepulchre, eventually dethrones the Queen of Silver and her council.
Chinese: 在陵墓城下溃烂的墓中人,最终掀翻了白银女王和她的议会。

English: After seizing control of Hallowshire, the Apostatic Union closes its borders to Endless refugees. Those who still manage to make the crossing are treated with scorn and derision.
Chinese: 叛教联盟夺取哈洛郡的控制权后,对无尽者难民关闭了边境。少数仍成功渡海而来的人,得到的只有轻蔑与嘲弄。

English: Paeguth looks upon these survivors with pity, offering many a place in the newly liberated Hallowshire.
Chinese: 帕古斯怜悯地注视着这些幸存者,邀请许多人来到新获解放的哈洛郡安家。

English: Some of the Endless even find their wretchedness to be alleviated by the transformative effects of Wikkan magic.
Chinese: 一些无尽者甚至发现,维坎魔法的转化之力减轻了他们的凄惨处境。

English: By calming the Entombed One's rage, you ensured that the Queen of Silver will reign over the Endless Realm for many a century more, while her subjects rest safely in the quiet gloom of their mausoleums.
Chinese: 你平息了墓中人的怒火,确保白银女王能继续统治无尽领域数个世纪,而她的子民安卧于陵墓幽暗的静谧之中。

English: And by aiding Penitent Thaw with her dilemma of sentient flesh, the Endless are able to remain self-sufficient. They continue to feast on meat that is (as far as anyone knows) lacking a mind of its own.
Chinese: 而你帮助忏悔者·索解开了有意识血肉的难题,无尽者得以自给自足。他们继续享用着(就所有人所知)没有自我意识的肉食。

English: Relations with the Apostatic Union continue to improve, and in time the two neighbours are known as firm and fast allies, united in their godlessness.
Chinese: 与叛教联盟的关系不断改善,最终这对邻居以坚不可摧的同盟闻名,共同坚守着无神的信条。

English: With Paeguth in control of Hallowshire, the two neighbours form an unusual alliance, pioneering arcane mysteries and magics to the chagrin of the Apostatic Union.
Chinese: 帕古斯掌控哈洛郡后,这对邻居结成了不同寻常的同盟,携手开拓玄奥的秘术与魔法,令叛教联盟懊恼不已。

English: But soon, it is made apparent that the Endless' flesh farms are an untenable form of sustenance. Lord Rhydder is able to convince the Endless to resume the Cadaver Crusades, and the Endless feast upon mortal flesh once more.
Chinese: 但很快,人们发现无尽者的血肉农场已难以为继。里德尔勋爵成功说服无尽者重启尸骸十字军,无尽者再次大啖凡人之肉。

English: The Apostatic Union retaliates with a declaration of war, and the full wrath of the Union Navy is brought down upon Sepulchre, razing it to the ground.
Chinese: 叛教联盟以宣战作为回应,联盟海军倾巢而出,将怒火倾泻在陵墓城上,把它夷为平地。

English: Still, the Endless prove tenacious, and for many years the mortals of the skyrealms live in fear of the Cadaver Corsairs.
Chinese: 尽管如此,无尽者依然顽强,此后多年,天空领域的凡人都生活在对尸骸海盗的恐惧之中。

English: Hallowshire, abundant in flesh thanks to Paeguth's new rule, proves a favoured hunting ground for the Endless. This conflict engulfs the Oneiric Isles for many years to come.
Chinese: 感谢帕古斯的新统治,哈洛郡血肉丰足,成了无尽者最钟爱的猎场。这场冲突将在未来多年席卷梦幻群岛。

English: In the Endless Realm, your plotting ensures that the Entombed One is able to defeat the Queen of Silver and her council.
Chinese: 在无尽领域,你的密谋确保了墓中人能够击败白银女王和她的议会。

English: Her presence amplifies the agonies and resentments of the island. In this new era of magical potency, their malaise comes to consume the region - until one day the Endless Realm simply disappears without warning or ceremony.
Chinese: 她的存在放大了这座岛屿的苦痛与怨愤。在这个魔法力量蓬勃的新时代,这股郁结之气逐渐吞噬了整个地区——直到有一天,无尽领域毫无征兆、无声无息地消失了。

English: In neighbouring Hallowshire, the common folk of the Apostatic Union barely remark on this strange occurrence; and those that do find they cannot quite remember what was on those islands in the first place.
Chinese: 在邻近的哈洛郡,叛教联盟的平民几乎没注意到这桩怪事;而注意到的人则发现,他们怎么也想不起那些岛上原本有些什么。

English: In time, very few ever mention the Endless, and scholars who take to their libraries for answers are often met with puzzlingly blank pages.
Chinese: 渐渐地,几乎无人再提起无尽者,去图书馆寻找答案的学者们,迎来的常常是令人费解的空白书页。

English: In neighbouring Hallowshire, the people of Paeguth's new domain barely notice this strange occurrence; and those that do find they cannot quite remember what was on those islands in the first place.
Chinese: 在邻近的哈洛郡,帕古斯新领地的人们几乎没注意到这桩怪事;而注意到的人则发现,他们怎么也想不起那些岛上原本有些什么。

English: Some Wikkan priests even try asking their gods, but the answer is always the same; that the ancient kingdom of Verdant was destroyed long ago, leaving nary a trace.
Chinese: 一些维坎祭司甚至试着询问他们的神明,得到的答案却始终如一:古老的翠绿王国早已毁灭,未留下一丝痕迹。

English: In the Endless Realm, the Entombed One's presence amplifies the agonies and resentments of the island.
Chinese: 在无尽领域,墓中人的存在放大了这座岛屿的苦痛与怨愤。

English: In this new era of magical potency, their malaise comes to consume the region - until one day the Endless Realm simply disappears without warning or ceremony.
Chinese: 在这个魔法力量蓬勃的新时代,这股郁结之气逐渐吞噬了整个地区——直到有一天,无尽领域毫无征兆、无声无息地消失了。

English: By calming the Entombed One's rage, you ensured that the Queen of Silver can lead her people into this era of possibility with a newfound hope.
Chinese: 你平息了墓中人的怒火,确保白银女王能带着焕然一新的希望,带领人民走进这个充满可能的时代。

English: Sure enough, the inhabitants of the Endless Realm soon find their skin a little more smooth, their throats a little less raspy. Some even notice saplings sprouting among the dead trees.
Chinese: 果不其然,无尽领域的居民很快发现自己的皮肤光滑了些,喉咙不再那么沙哑。有人甚至注意到,枯树之间冒出了新芽。

English: Relations with Hallowshire improve dramatically, for the common folk of the Apostatic Union seem to harbour less prejudice against those with blood in their cheeks.
Chinese: 与哈洛郡的关系突飞猛进,叛教联盟的平民对脸颊尚有血色之人的偏见似乎淡薄了许多。

English: In time, the newly titled Kingdom of Verdant and the neighbouring Union are known as firm allies, sharing commerce and culture alike.
Chinese: 最终,新命名的翠绿王国与邻邦联盟以稳固的盟友闻名,商贸与文化互通共享。

English: In time, the realm is known as the Kingdom of Verdant, and is regarded across the Skyrealms as a place of beauty and peace.
Chinese: 最终,这个国度以翠绿王国之名广为人知,被整个天空领域视为美丽与和平之地。

English: In a twist of irony, it is now the inhabitants of Verdant who peer across at their neighbours with curiosity and disgust; for the bizarre practices of Paeguth's Hallowshire seem abhorrent.
Chinese: 命运弄人,如今轮到翠绿居民好奇又厌恶地打量他们的邻居了——帕古斯治下哈洛郡的诡异习俗实在令人作呕。

English: With Aphra's reform plan thwarted, and without the power of the Angel to lean on, the Clockwork Kingdom soon collapses and is overtaken by the Corruption.
Chinese: 阿芙拉的改革计划受挫,又没有天使之力可以依靠,发条王国很快崩溃,被腐化吞没。

English: Just as Aphra predicted, it remains uninhabitable for centuries yet: a land of nightmares, oft cited in cautionary nursery rhymes and visited only by the bravest of treasure hunters.
Chinese: 正如阿芙拉所预言的,此后数百年它始终不宜居住:一片梦魇之地,常在吓诫孩童的童谣里被提起,只有最胆大的寻宝者才敢踏足。

English: Without the power of the Angel to lean on, and with no viable plan for reform, the Clockwork Kingdom soon collapses and is overtaken by the Corruption.
Chinese: 没有天使之力可以依靠,又没有可行的改革方案,发条王国很快崩溃,被腐化吞没。

English: It remains uninhabitable for centuries yet: a land of nightmares, oft cited in cautionary nursery rhymes and visited only by the bravest of treasure hunters.
Chinese: 此后数百年它始终不宜居住:一片梦魇之地,常在吓诫孩童的童谣里被提起,只有最胆大的寻宝者才敢踏足。

English: After an outbreak of Corruption in Hallowshire is suppressed at great cost, the Union Navy attaches gigantic sails to the island and lets it loose on the trade winds. For generations it drifts unpredictably through the Skyrealms, sowing terror in its wake.
Chinese: 腐化在哈洛郡爆发,联盟付出惨重代价将其镇压后,给整座岛屿装上巨大的风帆,任其在信风中飘荡。此后数代人,它都难以捉摸地漂泊于天空领域之间,所到之处散播恐惧。

English: The Cult of Paeguth seems oddly unfazed by the horror on their doorstep, and there are even whispers of 'diplomacy' with the Corrupted - though few believe such a thing to be possible.
Chinese: 帕古斯教团对家门口的恐怖显得出奇地镇定,甚至有传闻说他们在与腐化者进行"外交"——尽管几乎没人相信这种事可能发生。

English: With your help, the Clockwork King is restored to sanity, and the amnesia of its citizens recedes. After some turmoil, Aphra's reformists take charge and dismantle the old police state, presiding over a dawning optimism as people explore their new freedom to change.
Chinese: 在你的帮助下,发条王恢复了神智,国民的失忆逐渐消退。几经动荡后,阿芙拉的改革派接管政权,拆解了旧日的警察国家。人们探索着改变自我的全新自由,乐观情绪日益高涨。

English: In the years that follow it becomes increasingly difficult for outsiders to understand the Kingdom. Monarch and subjects continually reshape each other in ever-stranger feedback loops, while critics claim the populace have given up their humanity. Still, the technological results - and the happiness metrics - speak for themselves.
Chinese: 此后数年,外人越来越难理解这个王国。君王与国民在愈发怪异的反馈循环中不断互相重塑,批评者声称民众已经放弃了人性。不过,技术成果——还有幸福指数——自会说明一切。

English: With your help, the Clockwork King dies without an heir, and its courtiers are violently deposed. Though many citizens perish in that first brutal winter, this time a natural spring follows in its wake - along with a blossoming sense of mutual solidarity.
Chinese: 在你的帮助下,发条王死去,没有留下继承人,它的廷臣也被暴力推翻。虽然许多国民死在了第一个严酷的冬天,但这一次,春天如约而至——伴随而来的,还有蓬勃生长的互助情谊。

English: The Saboteurs' leadership ensures that people meet the crisis together, and soon the old songs - all-  the old songs - return to the tea rooms and temples. It also creates a safe haven for crooks and black marketeers, who swiftly become indispensable to society.
Chinese: 破坏者们的领导让大家共同应对危机,很快,古老的歌谣——所有的——古老的歌谣——重新回到了茶室与神殿。这里也成了骗子和黑市贩子的避风港,他们迅速成为社会中不可或缺的角色。

English: In response, the Union moves troops in from Hallowshire and occupies the island, announcing its intention to restore law and order. A long resistance struggle concludes with the declaration of New Kardova as a freebooting, fractious nomad republic.
Chinese: 作为回应,联盟从哈洛郡调兵占领了这座岛屿,宣称要恢复法律与秩序。漫长的抵抗斗争最终以新卡尔多瓦宣告成立而告终——一个自由不羁、野性难驯的游牧共和国。

English: Many lives are saved by generous aid from Wikkan Hallowshire, whose cultists sense an opportunity to spread the gospel of Paeguth. Religion once again becomes a flashpoint in the former Kingdom, with local apostates receiving covert backing from the Union.
Chinese: 维坎哈洛郡的慷慨援助拯救了许多生命,教团信徒们嗅到了传播帕古斯福音的机会。宗教再次成为前王国的火药桶,当地的叛教者则暗中接受着联盟的支持。

English: The Clockwork Kingdom is close to collapsing when the power of the Angel ripples through the cosmos, rescuing the King from its own blunders and investing it with unfathomable new power.
Chinese: 发条王国濒临崩溃之际,天使之力荡漾过宇宙,把国王从自己的昏招中拯救出来,并授予它深不可测的新力量。

English: Having thwarted Aphra's attempt at reform, Sunil and his old guard are free to rewrite reality as they please, creating a perfect little dictatorship where dissent is literally unimaginable.
Chinese: 挫败了阿芙拉的改革尝试后,苏尼尔和他的保守派元老得以随心所欲地改写现实,缔造了一个完美的小型独裁国——在那里,异见真正是无法想象的。

English: The Clockwork Kingdom is close to collapsing when the power of the Angel ripples through the cosmos, rescuing the King from its own blunders and investing it with unfathomable new power.
Chinese: 发条王国濒临崩溃之际,天使之力荡漾过宇宙,把国王从自己的昏招中拯救出来,并授予它深不可测的新力量。

English: With reformist voices scattered and disorganised, the King's courtiers are free to rewrite reality as they please, creating a perfect little dictatorship where dissent is literally unimaginable.
Chinese: 改革派的声音四散零落,国王的廷臣得以随心所欲地改写现实,缔造了一个完美的小型独裁国——在那里,异见真正是无法想象的。

English: In the Clockwork Kingdom, the power of the Angel supercharges Aphra's reforms beyond her wildest dreams. After a period of total chaos, the renamed Kingdom of New Kardova becomes a beacon of radical ingenuity, where anything is possible and ordinary folk reinvent themselves seven times before breakfast.
Chinese: 在发条王国,天使之力让阿芙拉的改革突飞猛进,远超她最狂野的想象。经历一段彻底的混乱后,更名的新卡尔多瓦王国成为激进创造力的灯塔:在那里一切皆有可能,普通人吃顿早饭前就能把自己重塑七次。

English: Kardovan society swiftly becomes incomprehensible to all but the most broad-minded outsiders, spreading lunatic machines and persistent reality glitches across the Skyrealms. Elders warn that those who emigrate there will forfeit their very humanity; but for surprisingly many people, that's the attraction.
Chinese: 卡尔多瓦社会很快变得令外人难以理解,只有心胸最开阔的人才能接受,疯癫的机器和挥之不去的现实故障也随之散播到整个天空领域。长者警告说,移民去那里的人将失去做人的资格;但出乎意料的是,对许多人而言,这正是魅力所在。

English: The Clockwork King is in its death throes when the power of the Angel ripples through it, disrupting Reza's spell and turning their orderly shutdown into a devastating miniature World Rend. Through a heroic sacrifice by the Saboteurs, most of the population escapes.
Chinese: 发条王正在垂死挣扎,天使之力却荡漾过它的躯体,扰乱了雷扎的咒法,把他们的有序关停变成了一场毁灭性的小型世界撕裂。多亏破坏者们英勇牺牲,大多数国民得以逃脱。

English: The survivors find that they have been gifted with extraordinary powers - but at the cost of disturbing the fabric of reality wherever they go. So they wander the Skyrealms as nomads, sometimes welcomed, sometimes spurned, carrying the new Kardova in their hearts and in the songs they pass down to their children.
Chinese: 幸存者们发现自己获得了非凡的力量——代价是所到之处都会扰动现实的织体。于是他们如游牧民般流浪于天空领域,时而受到欢迎,时而遭到驱逐,把新卡尔多瓦留在心中,唱进传给子孙后代的歌谣里。

English: So they wander the Skyrealms as nomads, sometimes welcomed, sometimes spurned, carrying the new Kardova in their hearts and in the songs they pass down to their children.
Chinese: 于是他们如游牧民般流浪于天空领域,时而受到欢迎,时而遭到驱逐,把新卡尔多瓦留在心中,唱进传给子孙后代的歌谣里。

English: The High Confessor spends the rest of her days in an Inquisition cell; where the last of her resolve drains away.
Chinese: 至高忏悔者在宗教裁判所的牢房中度过余生,最后的意志也在其中消磨殆尽。

English: The High Confessor is not witness to this new age, for though new power stirs within her - she sees no reason to leave the dank gloom of her prison.
Chinese: 至高忏悔者没能见证这个新时代,尽管新的力量在她体内苏醒,她却找不出任何理由离开阴暗潮湿的牢房。

English: After the Cradle Incident, The High Confessor's ingenuity is finally recognised. In time, she rises to the very top of the Inquisition, serving as Grand Inquisitor.
Chinese: 摇篮事件后,至高忏悔者的才干终于得到认可。最终她一路高升至宗教裁判所之巅,就任大审判官。

English: In this new age, the High Confessor's body is healed; and she steps out of her coffin as Caer once more.
Chinese: 在这个新时代,至高忏悔者的身体痊愈了;她走出棺木,再次成为了凯尔。

English: With Vela defeated, the chains that bound your mysterious benefactor shatter; freeing the entity at last.
Chinese: 薇拉败落,束缚你那神秘恩人的锁链应声而碎,终于解放了这个存在。

English: You never cross paths with it again.
Chinese: 你们此后再未相遇。

English: And in neighbouring Pwyll, the next Scryshroom harvest is plentiful indeed - though the mood is sombre, for the villagers know the blood-price that was paid.
Chinese: 而在邻近的普威尔,下一季窥菇收成确实丰厚——只是气氛凝重,因为村民们知道付出了怎样的血价。

English: And in neighbouring Pwyll, the Scryshroom harvest never quite recovers, with the village falling into destitution in the coming years. Lludd, however, travels the Skyrealms; finding awe and adventure.
Chinese: 而在邻近的普威尔,窥菇收成再没能恢复,村庄在此后数年陷入赤贫。不过卢德走遍了天空领域,寻得敬畏与冒险。

English: And in neighbouring Pwyll, an immense scryshroom forest grows; which grants all who step within it prophetic visions that unerringly prove true.
Chinese: 而在邻近的普威尔,一片巨大的窥菇森林拔地而起;凡踏入其中者,都会获得百试百灵的预言幻象。

English: And in neighbouring Pwyll, Lludd - in time - comes to be the town's mayor, and guides his people through this new age of wonders.
Chinese: 而在邻近的普威尔,卢德最终当上了镇长,带领人民走过这个充满奇迹的新时代。
